minimal_fixtures.purpose: Minimal generic positive observation with a source call and a closed signed carrier.
minimal_fixtures.source_design: A single pure identity entry on Int; no helpers, aggregates, accepted guarantee proof or refinement proof used as observation evidence.
minimal_fixtures.required_observation: Independently replayed safe theorem of the exact grounded source_call(-2) = -2. The literal expectation is a fixture specification, never an authoritative host evaluation.

minimal_fixtures.purpose: Minimal generic negative observation; compilation failure must not supply the negative polarity.
minimal_fixtures.source_design: A separate single pure entry returning x + 1 on Int. It is deliberately inconsistent with the identity guarantee and must not carry a fabricated refinement proof.
minimal_fixtures.required_observation: Independently replayed safe theorem of the negation of the exact grounded identity predicate. Admit ordinary source/goal structure without relying on a universal bridge proof.

unrelated_reproducer_requirement.statement: No particular Lean computational blocker is asserted. Before choosing S-GR-001 or S-GR-002, a new unrelated source/contract pair must produce the baseline's ordinary two-polarity construction failure with captured diagnostic evidence, and one proposed recipe must produce a fully audited exact ground result within the same limits.
allowed_generic_components: A nominal record with an Int field, finite enum field and List(Int) field.
A helper call with distinct parameter ordering.
Nested list map/filter/fold over explicitly finite lists.
A Nat fold returning an Int or record result.
Signed arithmetic and Int.fdiv through public generic semantics.
unrelated_reproducer_requirement.size_policy: Freeze a finite candidate set and permitted sizes before exploration. The proposed initial set is at most four independently written small fixtures, at most two finite assignments each, using list lengths 0 or 3 and Nat fold bounds 0 or 3. No unbounded search, repeated task-shaped tuning or extension based on the sealed task is authorized.
unrelated_reproducer_requirement.reduction_policy: If a permitted generic case reproduces the failure, freeze that case before comparison. A later smaller reproducer requires a new frozen fixture root; do not claim minimality without an explicit finite reduction plan.
unrelated_reproducer_requirement.if_baseline_succeeds: Record the successful generic control honestly. It does not reproduce the incident boundary or qualify a new strategy. If the frozen candidate set has no reproducer, C-GR-001 remains unresolved and qualification is BLOCKED.
unrelated_reproducer_requirement.prohibited_reproducer: The incident O6 assignment, its algorithm, task-specific carriers, accepted reference/formula answers or candidate source/proofs must not become a fixture.
